onboarding.welcomeText: A short walkthrough teaches the task module on the real interface. It is tailored to your role, and this task completes automatically when you finish.
onboarding.welcomeAdmin: Administrator guide: create and assign work, review approvals, people, and reports.
onboarding.welcomeMember: Team guide: your tasks, time tracking, checklists, comments, and completion requests.
onboarding.completedToast: Your first task is complete. You are ready to begin!
onboarding.error: The guide could not be completed. Please try again.

admin.title: Administrator task guide
admin.subtitle: Learn to manage your team's task flow from start to finish.

create.title: Create and assign a task
create.text: Use New task to set the title, assignees, start and due times, priority, and labels. Administrators can see every task.

follow.title: Follow progress live
follow.text: Board statuses, live timers, and checklist progress show exactly where the team stands.

approve.title: Review requests
approve.text: Approvals lets you accept or reject task proposals, completion requests, and deletion requests with a reason.

people.title: See results in people and reports
people.text: People shows workload; reports show time, completed work, and team performance.

member.title: Task quick-start guide
member.subtitle: Open assigned work, progress it, and send it for completion.

open.title: Open an assigned task
open.text: The task list only shows work assigned to you or created by you. Open a card to see its description, dates, and assignees.

track.title: Start and pause
track.text: Press Start when work begins and Pause when you stop. Time is not entered manually; the timer records real working time.

work.title: Use steps and communication
work.text: Tick checklist items, add a comment when needed, and upload documents from the Files tab.

complete.title: Request completion
complete.text: When the work is done, send a completion request. An administrator reviews and completes it or returns it with an explanation.
